title: Employees and their managers
prompt: The org chart needs every employee next to their manager's name. Write `solve(employees)` so it returns `employee_id`, `first_name`, `last_name`, `manager_first_name` and `manager_last_name`.
rules: An employee's manager is the employee whose `employee_id` equals their `manager_id`.
Every employee appears exactly once. If `manager_id` is missing or names nobody in the table, the manager's names are missing.
Return only these five columns, in this order.
hints: Match `F.col("e.manager_id")` with `F.col("m.employee_id")`. Which join type keeps employees with no manager?
